name: tc4.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-sort TopLevelDeclarations) (declare-const mk-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)
(declare-sort A) (declare-const mk-A A)
(declare-sort B) (declare-const mk-B B)

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-A this)
    (deref-is-B this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class A:
; ------------------------

(declare-fun A.foo (Ref Int) Int)

(define-fun A!foo ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (A.foo this x)
)

; ------------------------
;   Methods for class B:
; ------------------------

(define-fun B.foo ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x 2)
)

(define-fun B!foo ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x 2)
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-B B)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-B const-2-B))
  )
)
smtModel:
;; universe for TopLevelDeclarations:
;;   TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun TopLevelDeclarations!val!0 () TopLevelDeclarations)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x TopLevelDeclarations)) (= x TopLevelDeclarations!val!0))
;; -----------
;; universe for A:
;;   A!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun A!val!0 () A)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x A)) (= x A!val!0))
;; -----------
;; universe for B:
;;   B!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun B!val!0 () B)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x B)) (= x B!val!0))
;; -----------
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  A!val!0)
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!3))
(define-fun const-2-B () B
  B!val!0)
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-B B!val!0)
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A A!val!0)
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null))))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null))
(define-fun k!2 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A A!val!0)
  (ite (= x!1 0) (lift-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations!val!0)
    null)))
